method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Hong Kong: Policy support drives cautious re-engagement – BNY
Equities.summary: BNY’s Jackit Wong highlights that Hong Kong equities are the clearest near-term beneficiary of China’s broadened but still targeted policy support.
Equities.reason: Targeted Chinese policy support is a localized positive for Hong Kong/China equities amid a broader global risk-off; small-to-moderate positive signal relative to dominant market selloff.

Equities.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average drops for a fifth day as AI rout widens
Equities.summary: Five falls in five sessions have taken the Dow Jones Industrial Average more than 10% below its August record close, and the selling is no longer confined to artificial intelligence (AI) stocks. The index dropped to just under 48,000, its lowest since April, a
Equities.reason: Broadening selloff beyond AI names and multiple days of index declines signal elevated market risk-off and a shift away from the AI-led rally — strong negative for equities regime.

Equities.title: S&P 500 and Dow close in correction; Nasdaq erases 2026 gain
Equities.reason: Major US indices entering correction territory (S&P/Dow) and Nasdaq losing year-to-date gains is a high-impact regime shift indicating heightened downside risk for equities.

Equities.title: US Stock Futures Fall as Anthropic IPO Fails to Quell AI Worries
Equities.reason: Futures weakness tied to Anthropic's IPO disappointment shows AI-specific shock transmitting into broader market panic — meaningful negative near-term for equities.

Equities.title: Anthropic’s IPO Bust Punctuates $4 Trillion AI Wipeout on Wall Street
Equities.reason: Framing of a multi-trillion-dollar AI 'wipeout' signals a core narrative break in the AI leadership trade — high-relevance negative for market regime and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
Equities.summary: Once the most valuable company in the world, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.
Equities.reason: Nvidia is the epicenter of the AI leadership narrative; a large, sustained plunge materially worsens market risk sentiment and pressures sector indices — significant negative.

Equities.title: Nvidia Said to Face S.E.C. Probe Into Its Accounting Practices
Equities.reason: Regulatory scrutiny of the sector's flagship company raises governance and earnings-risk concerns that amplify downside pressure on tech/AI equities.

Equities.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
Equities.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has faced a flurry of criticism on Capitol Hill in the wake of his involvement with a suspected Chinese spy.
Equities.reason: High-profile political and regulatory attention on Nvidia's leadership adds headline risk and uncertainty for investors in AI-related equities.

Equities.title: China’s $1.7 Trillion AI Rout Turns Hot Trade Into Losing Bet
Equities.reason: Large-scale losses in China AI names indicate the correction is global and undermines the crowded AI long trade, increasing systemic equity risk.

Equities.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
Equities.summary: Odds that the S&P 500 will cross 8,000, which were once north of 70%, are extremely low on platform Kalshi.
Equities.reason: Market-implied probabilities shifting lower via prediction markets reflects reduced investor confidence in continued equity upside — reinforcing negative market regime.

Equities.title: VIEW Nasdaq plunges 5% a day after Anthropic debut, but investors still believe in AI
Equities.reason: Short-term plunge is noted, but the piece highlights lingering investor conviction in AI — a lower-relevance counter-signal to the dominant negative narrative.

Equities.title: AI tech rout prompts US investors to rush into value stocks
Equities.reason: Evidence of rotation away from growth/AI into value is a meaningful regime signal: negative for growth leadership but indicates a repositioning rather than blanket equity stability.

Rates.title: US 10-year Treasury yield slips below 5% as global equity rout deepens
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields fall across the curve on Friday, extending their weekly decline as a sharp sell-off in global equities drives demand for government bonds. The benchmark 10-year yield trades at 4.98%, down more than 13 basis points so far this week.
Rates.reason: Clear bond rally: material intra-week decline in the 10yr (below 5%) driven by flight-to-safety from equity rout. Direct, high‑relevance positive for bond prices (yields down).

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Market prices in December and January hikes – Rabobank
Rates.summary: Rabobank strategist Molly Schwartz notes that OIS pricing now reflects expectations for a full Federal Reserve rate hike in December and a high probability of another move in January.
Rates.reason: Markets pricing in additional Fed hikes is directly negative for bond prices (higher-for-longer yields); this is a meaningful policy-expectations signal that pressures rates higher.

Rates.title: Bank of Korea: Tightening bias holds into November – DBS
Rates.summary: DBS Group Research expects the Bank of Korea (BoK) to raise its policy rate by 25bp to 3.25% at the November 26 meeting, despite acknowledging a close decision. The team highlights solid exports, firm PMIs and inflation above target as key drivers.
Rates.reason: Near-term central bank tightening (BoK 25bp) implies higher local rates and contributes to global tightening narrative; modestly negative for bond prices, especially in regional EM/Asia markets.

Rates.title: Warsh wants Fed officials to talk less. Instead, they’re talking more
Rates.summary: Fed officials have been rushing to the microphones lately while the Fed chairman stays on the sidelines.
Rates.reason: Heightened Fed communications (fragmented messaging) can lift uncertainty/term premium and weigh modestly on bond prices; relevant to market pricing but not a direct policy move.

FX.title: British Pound: More upside versus EUR than USD – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad reports that GBP/USD has bounced back above 1.3100 after briefly touching a one‑year low. Haddad notes that stronger‑than‑expected UK October retail sales support expectations for a December Bank of England (BoE) ra
FX.reason: GBP strength narrative vs USD/EUR driven by retail surprise and BoE-hike expectations. Direct GBP/USD implication makes this FX-relevant; moderate relevance since it is a regional, short-term catalyst.

FX.title: The British Pound goes into PMI week paying for softer inflation and slower pay
FX.summary: UK inflation and pay growth both came in under forecast, which is good news for British households and was the reason the Pound fell.
FX.reason: Softer domestic inflation/pay metrics reduce BoE tightening expectations and pressure GBP vs USD. High relevance for GBP/USD positioning into economic calendar (PMIs).

FX.title: Australian Dollar: Softer jobs data fuel rate-cut speculation – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Norman Liebke notes that weak Australian labour market data, including a 43,500 fall in employment and a rise in unemployment to 4.9%, reinforce expectations that the RBA’s hiking cycle has ended. Markets now price rate cuts by 2027, and upcoming
FX.reason: Weaker labour data increases RBA cut pricing, weighing on AUD vs USD. Clear monetary-policy transmission to AUD/USD justifies high relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar Index (DXY) hesitates below 104.00 as AI jitters offset Fed hiking bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) is trimming daily losses during the European session on Friday but maintains a moderate bearish tone, as a selloff in AI stocks starts to hit the Greenback.
FX.reason: DXY is the central USD gauge; article signals a pause in USD strength driven by risk/tech flows and Fed-hike repricing. High relevance because DXY moves drive cross-currency dynamics.

FX.title: The Euro takes a priced-in hike into a week that belongs to American inflation
FX.summary: 1.1000 has turned EUR/USD back in each of the past three sessions, and it did so in a week when most of the news leaned the Euro's way. Eurozone core inflation was revised higher, the ZEW sentiment survey beat its forecast, and the US factory numbers missed.
FX.reason: Euro showing resilience on domestic data and priced ECB moves, but US inflation-facing calendar is a near-term risk. Relevant for EUR/USD positioning; moderate relevance reflecting mixed drivers.

FX.title: Euro edges higher as US Dollar eases, still set for third weekly loss
FX.summary: EUR/USD trades on the front foot on Friday as a modest pullback in the US Dollar (USD) puts the brakes on the Euro’s (EUR) decline after the pair fell to levels last seen in May 2025 earlier this week.
FX.reason: Direct EUR/USD move tied to a pullback in USD; reinforces a near-term EUR recovery theme. Relevance elevated due to ongoing weekly trend and DXY linkage.

FX.title: Japanese Yen outperforms as global stock sell-off lifts safe-haven demand
FX.summary: USD/JPY falls on Friday as a sharp sell-off in global equities rattles financial markets and boosts safe-haven demand for the Japanese Yen (JPY), which is outperforming all of its major peers. A softer US Dollar (USD) adds to the pressure on the pair.
FX.reason: Equity-driven safe-haven flows lifting JPY reduce USD/JPY. Clear cross-asset transmission makes this relevant for USD direction and FX flows.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Brief dip against US Dollar prompts controls - Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Michael Pfister reports an unusual, sudden jump in USD/CNY without a corresponding Dollar move, which some linked to a recent US-Russia-China summit.
FX.reason: A sudden USD/CNY spike and ensuing controls signal CNY weakness/volatility and potential policy intervention. Important for EM/FX risk and USD/CNY dynamics; relevance high due to direct intervention implications.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Gradual appreciation under tight management – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Jackit Wong sees the Chinese Yuan on a path of gradual, closely managed appreciation supported by Renminbi (RMB) internationalization. The recent FX reserve requirement hike is interpreted as moderating the pace of Chinese Yuan (CNY) gains rather than re
FX.reason: Medium-term managed CNY appreciation implies some USD weakness vs RMB and structural FX policy. Relevant for RMB/Risk-EM flow narratives but lower immediate market impact than intervention news.

FX.title: Malaysian Ringgit: Chip export curbs and yields pressure MYR against US Dollar – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong report that new US export restrictions on advanced AI chips have driven USD/MYR above 4.11, overshadowing stronger Malaysian Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data.
FX.reason: US policy (export curbs) and global yield dynamics driving MYR depreciation vs USD. Direct USD/MYR impact and policy-driven flow justify moderate relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah: BI measures cushion losses against US Dollar - OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong note that Bank Indonesia’s (BI) 25bp hike to 6.00% and enhanced FX hedging incentives have helped temper depreciation pressures on the Rupiah despite a firm US Dollar (USD) and high US yields.
FX.reason: Firm USD/high US yields are pressuring IDR, but BI policy actions have meaningfully cushioned the move. Signals persistent USD strength for EMFX while highlighting policy offset — relevant to EM FX risk.

FX.title: Canadian retail sales give the Loonie a pause at a 19-month low
FX.summary: Seven gains in eight sessions took USD/CAD to a 19-month high on Thursday, and Friday's pullback has given back very little of them. The pair has slipped from just above 1.4350 and hasn't traded below Thursday's low.
FX.reason: USD/CAD near multi-month highs driven by USD strength and CAD weakness; retail data gave only a shallow pause. Relevant for commodity FX flows but lower immediacy than DXY/EUR/JPY moves.

FX.title: Hungarian Forint: HUF pressured by MNB stance and inflation doubts – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose argues that the Hungarian central bank’s dovish stance, framed by talk of improved risk premia and euro adoption, has become a liability for the Forint.
FX.reason: Dovish MNB stance implies HUF weakness (mostly vs EUR and broadly vs major currencies). Lower relevance given the small-market footprint and limited USD-centric focus.

FX.title: Euro: Cross-border capital flows support the currency – MUFG
FX.summary: Derek Halpenny at MUFG highlights that ECB balance of payments data show supportive Euro flows in 2026, with current account, FDI and portfolio accounts collectively positive. The Euro-zone maintains a sizeable current account surplus, while equity inflows and
FX.reason: Structural capital-flow support is a constructive medium-term factor for EUR vs USD. Relevant for regime/context but lower immediacy than calendar-driven or DXY stories.

Commodities.title: Gold: Bull case shaken yet intact – TD Securities
Commodities.summary: TD Securities’ Ryan McKay and Bart Melek note that Gold has suffered intensified selling on risk-off flows and a hawkish Federal Reserve profile, with CTAs already short and discretionary length likely reduced. However, they argue this does not mark a full cap
Commodities.reason: Gold-focused sell-off tied to risk-off and hawkish Fed -> negative for gold prices. TD Securities view is market-relevant and reinforces broader downside risk; high relevance for the gold market.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for worst week since March as Fed rate hike bets and forced selling weigh
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trades under pressure on Friday, hitting its lowest level since September 2025 in Asian trading. A sell-off in global equities fuels volatility across financial markets as Anthropic’s record IPO does little to ease concerns about stretched AI va
Commodities.reason: Reports of forced selling and Fed rate-hike repricing point to meaningful near-term downside for gold. Strong market-moving narrative (forced flows + macro) justifies elevated relevance and negative direction.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD eyes 200-week SMA amid sustained selling pressure
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) extends its sell-off on Friday, slipping to levels last seen in September 2025. At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades around $42, about 65% below its January record high near $121, and is on track for its worst week since March.
Commodities.reason: Sustained selling in silver mirrors weakness in gold and risk-off flows; negative for silver pricing. Technical/price-focus limits relevance somewhat vs. broader supply-driven stories.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: Higher throughput through Middle East chokepoints implies stronger crude flows to market, a modest negative for oil prices. Relevant for oil supply dynamics but not an immediate shock.

Commodities.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027

Commodities.reason: Material multi-year production increase from Alaska adds to supply outlook for crude (WTI-relevant), a modest negative for oil prices. Relevant to medium-term fundamental balances.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Near-term Gulf Coast production shut-ins create a tangible supply disruption risk for oil/gas, supportive for prices. Elevated relevance due to immediacy and potential operational impacts.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: Inventories finishing the injection season above normal weigh on natural gas prices into winter; clear negative fundamental signal with above-average relevance for gas markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin struggles below $60,000 as mining profits plunge, security risks grow
Crypto.reason: Falling mining profitability and rising security concerns increase sell pressure and network risk for BTC; meaningful market-level negative signal.

Crypto.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
Crypto.reason: Idiosyncratic large XRP unwind and ETF asset drawdown weigh on altcoin risk appetite; relevant but lower-systemic impact than BTC moves.

Crypto.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
Crypto.reason: Institutional/product adoption: tokenized stock venue and SEC experimentation on Ethereum signals regulatory engagement and potential on‑ramps for capital.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
Crypto.reason: Immediate exploitation of exposed keys underscores front‑running/bot risks and custody vulnerabilities—negative for user confidence and onchain security.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
Crypto.reason: Large forced liquidations drove volatility; the bounce shows short-term resilience but overall narrative is deleveraging-driven risk-off pressure.

Crypto.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
Crypto.reason: Cross‑chain vault drain is a material exploit event undermining DeFi trust and cross‑chain primitives; significant negative for protocol-level risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
Crypto.reason: Technical node vulnerability discovered (AI-assisted); negative for network robustness but limited immediate market impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
Crypto.reason: Major price break to multi‑year lows signals broad market risk‑off and potential regime shift in crypto sentiment and risk premia — high systemic relevance.

Crypto.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
Crypto.reason: Regulatory extension to intermediaries increases formal oversight and could boost institutional confidence / market access — net positive for long‑term adoption.

Crypto.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
Crypto.reason: Restrictive legislation targeted at prediction markets constrains a subset of crypto products and signals regulatory limits; modest negative for product expansion.

Crypto.title: Coinbase targets first-half 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
Crypto.reason: Major exchange planning prediction market rollout indicates product innovation and potential new on‑ramps for trading volumes — positive adoption signal.

Crypto.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
Crypto.reason: CFTC stance of no special carveouts implies existing regulatory framework applies to onchain venues — increases compliance risk and uncertainty for operators.

Crypto.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
Crypto.reason: Massive selloff tied to issuer-linked wallet highlights counterparty and wrapping risks for privacy tokens — sharp negative shock for that segment and contagion risk to trust.

Crypto.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
Crypto.reason: Miner distress and asset sales create potential incremental sell pressure on BTC and signal stress in the mining sector; negative for supply dynamics.

Crypto.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
Crypto.reason: Institutional inflows reversing prior selling is a meaningful demand signal and supports a constructive medium‑term outlook for BTC.
